//: Rainmaker's campaign for Rainmaker. No statistic, no customer count, no testimonial — there are no customers to quote, and a guess set in the brand's real typeface reads as measured fact. Every line here is something the product actually does.
eyebrow: Made by the thing it advertises
headline: Say what you’re selling. Rainmaker builds the campaign.
subhead: One sentence from you becomes a landing page, social posts, an email sequence, the artwork and a captioned vertical ad. You approve every word before any of it goes out.
left_title: Getting a campaign out by hand
left_items: The page waits on whoever has time to build one.
Posts, email and page drift apart in three tools.
Artwork is a separate ask in someone else’s queue.
By the time it is all live, the idea has gone cold.
right_items: One sentence from the operator starts the build.
Page, posts and email written from that one sentence.
Artwork drawn, vertical ad cut and captioned.
The page goes up and the leads come back to you.
benefits: A landing page, social posts and an email sequence, from one sentence.
Artwork and a captioned vertical ad, drawn in your own colours.
Published to its own address, with every lead collected in one place.
Nothing goes out until you have approved the words.
form_blurb: Leave a number and we’ll send you the campaign Rainmaker built for itself — this page, the artwork, the posts and the ad.
privacy_note: One message, then nothing else. No list, no sharing.
success_message: Sent. Look out for it on WhatsApp.
